desc:
The Classic Game: Hug or Pass!

Dive into the fun as either the Hugger or one of the Contenders!

As the Hugger, you decide – will you "Hug" or "pass" on a contender?

As a Contender, it’s your moment to shine! Convince the Hugger why they should "Hug" you, or get ready for a "pass!"

❓ Will you get an epic hug or be passed by?
Report bugs in our community server below!
⭐️👍 Love the game? Give it a like and favorite!
